posts.title: Automation is just laziness with good architecture :)
posts.summary:
Why do the same task a hundred times when you can build a system to do it once? Automation isn't about avoiding work; it's about eliminating repetitive work so you can focus on things that actually matter. From writing a simple script to designing a complex workflow, the goal is always the same: work smarter, save time, and let technology handle the boring stuff.

A little laziness can spark a lot of creativity. Behind every automated process is someone who got tired of doing things the hard way and decided to build a better way.

Work less on repetition. Think more. Build smarter. Automate everything you reasonably can.

Because sometimes, the laziest person in the room has the best architecture. ;)
